blocks.p: The *Furniture* tab of the *World* window works on the furniture in the world. Choose a mode at the top of the tab, then point at a piece: the tab shows a card for it.

caption: Figure 29-1
The Furniture tab, with an Outdoor Bench under the pointer.

blocks.p: The card gives the piece's name, whether the mode can be used on it, and what that takes: encumbrance, skill, tool and the chance to break. The piece is also listed under *On this tile*.

marks.text: Five modes: Pick up, Place, Rotate, Disassemble and Repair. The lit one is in use.
Choose a mode, then point at furniture in the world.

sticky.text: Furniture: pick a mode, then point at a piece.

caption: Figure 29-2
The Foraging tab while searching, and its foot.

blocks.p: To start looking, click *Search* at the foot of the tab; while you search, the button reads *Stop searching*. *More detail* opens the categories in range and the modifiers.

marks.text: The tags give the zone's conditions, movement, season and weather.
The pop-up picks a category to look for.
The search radius in tiles, and the net change from modifiers.
Finds are listed with distance, name and weight.
Crouch and Aim only show your stance.
This button starts or stops the search.
